statements.restatement: T_65 face, d = 1, a, p, e, c > 0, q, b, j >= 0. Every realizable cost with I: e <= j, or II: ab >= 1 and e >= j, has Phi >= 0 on SO(4). It includes q = 0, b = 0 where compatible, and j = 0 in II; it excludes the faces a, p, e, c = 0. The region ab < 1, e > j is not covered.
